title: Is the education gap in generative AI use smaller than the internet's was at a similar level of use? Evidence from 16 European countries
abstract: arXiv:2610.36181v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: New technologies are usually adopted first by people with more formal education. This paper asks whether the education gap in generative AI use in 2025 is smaller or larger than the internet's gap in the same country in the year when overall internet use was at a similar level. It uses public Eurostat survey data on ICT usage by individuals aged 16 to 74. Each country's 2025 rate of generative AI use in the last three months is matched to the internet year whose overall last-three-months use was closest, within 5 percentage points, and the gap between people with high (ISCED 5 to 8) and low (ISCED 0 to 2) completed education is measured as a log ratio and as a percentage-point difference. Sixteen of 35 countries could be matched; most of the others were early internet adopters. translated_title: 生成式AI使用中的教育差距是否小于互联网在相似使用水平时的差距？来自16个欧洲国家的证据
translated_abstract: 新技术通常首先被受过更多正规教育的人所采用。本文探讨的问题是：2025年生成式AI使用中的教育差距，与同一国家在整体互联网使用处于相似水平的那一年互联网的教育差距相比，是更小还是更大。研究使用了欧盟统计局关于16至74岁个体信息通信技术（ICT）使用的公开调查数据。将每个国家2025年过去三个月的生成式AI使用率，与该国整体互联网过去三个月使用率最接近（差距在5个百分点以内）的年份进行匹配，并以对数比率和百分点差异来衡量高学历（ISCED 5至8）与低学历（ISCED 0至2）人群之间的差距。35个国家中有16个可以匹配，其余大多数属于互联网的早期采用国家。在匹配的国家中，按对数比率计算，16个国家中有13个国家的生成式AI教育差距更小（中位数变化为-0.625，95%自助法置信区间为-0.969至-0.291）。
tldr: 该研究通过将16个欧洲国家2025年的生成式AI使用率与互联网使用率相当的年份匹配对比，发现生成式AI使用中的教育差距在大多数国家（13/16）小于互联网普及早期在相似使用水平时的差距，表明生成式AI的普及在教育维度上比互联网初期更为平等。
en_tdlr: By matching 2025 generative AI usage rates with comparable historical internet adoption years across 16 European countries, the study finds the education gap in generative AI use was smaller than the internet's at a similar level of use in 13 of 16 countries, suggesting more equitable diffusion across education levels than early internet adoption.
